cues.en: This is the Global News Podcast from the BBC World Service.
cues.zh: 这里是 BBC World Service 的《Global News Podcast》。

cues.en: Hi, I'm Ankur Desai, and at 14:00 GMT on Tuesday, 25 August, these are our main stories.
cues.zh: 你好，我是 Ankur Desai。8月25日星期二格林尼治时间14点，以下是本期主要新闻。

cues.en: But China, the biggest buyer of Iranian oil, says it opposes what it calls illegal unilateral sanctions.
cues.zh: 但伊朗石油最大买家中国表示，反对其所称的非法单边制裁。

cues.en: A report says flooding in East Africa, caused by a supercharged El Niño, could result in the displacement of 3 million people.
cues.zh: 一份报告称，强烈厄尔尼诺引发的东非洪灾，可能导致300万人流离失所。

cues.en: And there's mounting concern over Haiti's ability to stage elections this year after another mass killing by armed gangs.
cues.zh: 武装帮派再次发动大规模杀戮后，人们越来越担心海地能否在今年举行选举。

cues.en: Also in this podcast: This is the visible effect of the man-made climate crisis.
cues.zh: 本期播客还将关注：这就是人为气候危机带来的显著影响。

cues.en: Normally we have 2 million litres of water each second, that's really a huge amount.
cues.zh: 正常情况下，我们每秒有200万升水，那真的是非常巨大的水量。

cues.en: But because of the drought, we have just about 600,000.
cues.zh: 但由于干旱，现在每秒只有大约60万升。

cues.en: Water levels in Europe's second-longest river, responsible for generating half of Austria's energy, are at their lowest levels for 30 years.
cues.zh: 欧洲第二长河、负责供应奥地利一半能源的多瑙河，水位降至30年来最低。

cues.en: A brutal attack on a Haitian farming community has again highlighted instability and raised concerns about safety and the possibility of December's democratic elections.
cues.zh: 海地一个农业社区遭到残酷袭击，再次凸显当地局势不稳，也加剧了人们对安全以及定于12月举行的民主选举能否实现的担忧。

cues.en: At least 47 people were killed in a gang raid on a hillside community near the capital, Port-au-Prince, which is mostly controlled by a coalition of armed gangs.
cues.zh: 至少47人在一次帮派袭击中丧生，遇袭的是首都太子港附近的山坡社区；太子港大部分地区由武装帮派联盟控制。

cues.en: Many of the dead had been sheltering in a church in Kenscoff.
cues.zh: 许多死者当时正在肯斯科夫的一座教堂里避难。

cues.en: I saw 45 to 50 dead people with my own eyes, not counting those they took away and those who are still missing.
cues.zh: 我亲眼看到45到50具尸体，还不包括他们带走的，以及仍然失踪的人。

cues.en: Those who died were young people who were the future of this country.
cues.zh: 死者都是年轻人，他们本来是这个国家的未来。

cues.en: We live in humiliation. The government have nothing for us. They do nothing, nothing for us.
cues.zh: 我们活在屈辱之中。政府什么也没有给我们。他们什么也不做，什么也不为我们做。

cues.en: The blood of the population does not stop flowing in Kenscoff. We can't take it anymore.
cues.zh: 肯斯科夫民众的鲜血流淌不止。我们再也无法承受了。

cues.en: I heard more from our World Affairs correspondent, Paul Moss.
cues.zh: 我们的《World Affairs》记者保罗·莫斯带来了更多消息。

cues.en: Kenscoff has suffered particularly simply because it's in what's considered a strategic position.
cues.zh: 肯斯科夫之所以遭受特别严重的打击，原因很简单：它处于一个被认为具有战略意义的位置。

cues.en: It looks down over Port-au-Prince, the capital.
cues.zh: 它俯瞰首都太子港。

cues.en: It also looks down on some of the roads that go in and out of the capital.
cues.zh: 它还俯瞰着一些进出首都的道路。

cues.en: So gangs feel that if they can control Kenscoff, they control a lot of what goes in and out.
cues.zh: 因此，帮派认为，只要控制肯斯科夫，就能控制大量进出首都的人和物资。

cues.en: But yes, sadly, what happened there is all too typical.
cues.zh: 但很遗憾，那里的遭遇实在太典型了。

cues.en: I mean, one thing that's typical, Kenscoff has a police station, and by the accounts of some residents, there were police who tried to intervene.
cues.zh: 我的意思是，肯斯科夫有一处警察局，这一点就很典型；一些居民说，警察曾试图介入。

cues.en: But in the end they proved completely ineffectual, and as we've been hearing, dozens of people were killed.
cues.zh: 但最终事实证明他们完全无能为力；正如我们听到的，有几十人丧生。

cues.en: But Haiti is a country where there are police, there is an army, and there's some semblance of government.
cues.zh: 但海地是一个有警察、有军队，也有某种政府雏形的国家。

cues.en: But they actually have almost no power, and the country is effectively run by gangs.
cues.zh: 但实际上，他们几乎没有权力，这个国家事实上由帮派控制。

cues.en: And what's awful is this is nothing new.
cues.zh: 更糟糕的是，这并不是什么新鲜事。

cues.en: I mean, the current wave of violence began when the last president was assassinated, Jovenel Moïse, in 2021.
cues.zh: 我的意思是，当前这波暴力始于上一任总统若弗内尔·莫伊兹于2021年遇刺。

cues.en: But Haiti has never really had a chance.
cues.zh: 但有人会说，海地从来没有真正得到过机会。

cues.en: Some would say this is a country that, when it got independence, France gave it a huge debt in compensation,
cues.zh: 有人会说，海地独立时，法国以赔偿为名让这个国家背负了巨额债务，

cues.en: which it took most of its independence years to pay off.
cues.zh: 海地用了独立后的大部分岁月才还清。

cues.en: Then it was ruled by one of the cruelest dictators I think the world has seen, a man called Papa Doc Duvalier.
cues.zh: 之后，海地又被我认为世上最残酷的独裁者之一统治——此人名叫“爸爸博士”杜瓦利埃。

cues.en: It's a country which suffers from earthquakes, has had a cholera outbreak.
cues.zh: 这是一个饱受地震之苦、还曾爆发霍乱的国家。

cues.en: There really is no central power, and the place is run by marauding gangs.
cues.zh: 那里确实没有中央权力，整个地方由横行的帮派控制。

cues.en: Now, Paul, a new UN gang suppression force is building up there, but previous UN attempts have failed.
cues.zh: 保罗，一支新的联合国帮派镇压部队正在那里组建，但联合国此前的尝试都失败了。

cues.en: Is there any hope the new one could make a difference when fully assembled?
cues.zh: 这支新部队全部就位后，有希望带来改变吗？

cues.en: The gang suppression force sounds optimistic, but as you suggest,
cues.zh: “帮派镇压部队”听起来颇为乐观，但正如你所说，

cues.en: this is just the latest attempt to control things.
cues.zh: 这不过是控制局势的最新一次尝试。

cues.en: I mean, first of all, this gang suppression force, when it gets its full complement of police.
cues.zh: 首先，这支帮派镇压部队在警察人员全部到位后，

cues.en: And soldiers in, it's supposed to be in October.
cues.zh: 还要有士兵加入，预计将在十月到位。

cues.en: It'll be five and a half thousand people.
cues.zh: 总人数将达到5500人。

cues.en: Just to put that in perspective, we're speaking in London, a very calm city by international standards.
cues.zh: 作为对比，我们现在谈的是伦敦——按国际标准来说，这是一座非常平静的城市。

cues.en: There are 50,000 police and support staff to control this city.
cues.zh: 伦敦有5万名警察和后勤人员负责维持这座城市的秩序。

cues.en: They're talking about 5,000 to control the whole of Haiti,
cues.zh: 而他们谈的是用5000人控制整个海地，

cues.en: a country which is, as you've described, violent chaos.
cues.zh: 这个国家正如你所描述的，陷于暴力混乱之中。

cues.en: And there have been these sort of forces before. We had the multinational security force
cues.zh: 此前也出现过类似部队。我们曾有过多国安全部队，

cues.en: that was supposed to be built up by Kenya, that was supposed to control the violence.
cues.zh: 原本应由肯尼亚组建，用来控制暴力局势。

cues.en: In fact, they never reached the planned numbers or got the staff they needed.
cues.zh: 事实上，他们从未达到计划人数，也从未拥有所需的人员。

cues.en: Before that, there was a UN stabilization mission in Haiti from 2004, I think, until 2017.
cues.zh: 在那之前，联合国还曾于2004年至——我想是2017年——在海地执行稳定任务。

cues.en: The legacy of that is all around.
cues.zh: 那项任务留下的影响随处可见。

cues.en: So, I don't want to be pessimistic, but you can understand why people in Haiti are very skeptical
cues.zh: 所以我不想悲观，但你可以理解海地人为何非常怀疑，

cues.en: about whether this is going to achieve any more than previous ones.
cues.zh: 这次行动是否会比以往的行动取得更多成果。

cues.en: Our World Affairs correspondent, Paul Moss.
cues.zh: 本台国际事务记者保罗·莫斯。

cues.en: This is the Global News Podcast.
cues.zh: 这里是《全球新闻播客》。

cues.en: Recent weeks have brought warnings of extreme weather around the world this year due to a super El Niño,
cues.zh: 最近几周的预警称，超级厄尔尼诺可能导致今年全球出现极端天气，

cues.en: a climate pattern in the tropical Pacific caused by warm ocean temperatures.
cues.zh: 这是一种由海洋温度升高导致的热带太平洋气候模式。

cues.en: Now East Africa is predicted to be hit by extreme rainfall and flooding later this year,
cues.zh: 目前预测东非今年晚些时候将遭遇极端降雨和洪灾，

cues.en: which could leave up to 3 million people displaced.
cues.zh: 可能导致多达300万人流离失所。

cues.en: I got more on this from our Africa correspondent, Thomas Naadi.
cues.zh: 我们的非洲记者托马斯·纳迪将带来更多信息。

cues.en: The report is a warning from the Danish Refugee Council here in East Africa,
cues.zh: 这份报告是东非的丹麦难民委员会发出的警告，

cues.en: says that a number of countries, including Kenya, Somalia and Uganda, could be facing higher than usual rainfall.
cues.zh: 报告称，包括肯尼亚、索马里和乌干达在内的一些国家，可能面临高于往常的降雨量。

cues.en: And that falls in line with what global alerts have been, that we might be facing an El Niño that is the worst in human memory.
cues.zh: 这与全球预警相符：我们可能正面临人类记忆中最严重的一次厄尔尼诺。

cues.en: The last time this happened in Kenya at a massive scale was in 1998.
cues.zh: 上一次肯尼亚大规模发生这种情况是在1998年。

cues.en: When rain across ten months broke health systems and infrastructure, around 100,000 kilometres of road were destroyed, and up to 2,000 people died.
cues.zh: 连续十个月的降雨导致医疗系统和基础设施瘫痪，约十万公里道路被毁，最多造成两千人死亡。

cues.en: And the last time this happened in the region, in 2024, it was much less severe here in Kenya, but severe in Tanzania.
cues.zh: 上一次该地区发生这种情况是在2024年；肯尼亚的灾情轻得多，但坦桑尼亚很严重。

cues.en: Around 155 people died, and 45 people died here in Kenya.
cues.zh: 约155人死亡，其中45人死在肯尼亚。

cues.en: Usually, when higher-than-usual rainfall happens across the country, mostly in the central part, it causes a lot of disruption here in Nairobi.
cues.zh: 通常，全国降雨高于正常水平时，主要在中部地区，会给这里的内罗毕带来许多混乱。

cues.en: You often see roads flooding, and many times people drowning in their homes and in their cars in the most severe cases.
cues.zh: 你经常会看到道路被淹；在最严重的情况下，人们还会在家中或车里溺亡。

cues.en: You mentioned Somalia, Kenya, South Sudan and Uganda.
cues.zh: 你提到了那里的一些国家：索马里、肯尼亚和南苏丹，也提到了乌干达。

cues.en: How prepared are these countries for an event like this? Kenya's Disaster Authority says it is preparing for the worst-case scenario and
cues.zh: 但这些国家为这样的事件做好了多少准备？肯尼亚灾害管理机构称，正为最坏情况做准备，而

cues.en: the same is happening in DRC.
cues.zh: 刚果民主共和国也在这样做。

cues.en: DRC is known to be facing Ebola right now, but they might be facing this problem as well, because this sweeps across the entire region.
cues.zh: 刚果民主共和国目前正面临埃博拉疫情，也可能面临这一问题，因为这场灾害会席卷整个地区。

cues.en: The risk is most severe in Kenya and Somalia, where the governments and the Danish Refugee Council estimate
cues.zh: 肯尼亚和索马里的风险最为严重。两国政府和丹麦难民委员会估计，

cues.en: that, in a worst-case scenario, 60% to 70% of the 3 million people displaced would be in those two countries.
cues.zh: 最坏情况下，在300万流离失所者中，约60%至70%会来自这两个国家。

cues.en: But the Kenyan government says that it's preparing heavily. Historically, it's not known to prepare effectively for such disasters.
cues.zh: 但肯尼亚政府称正全力准备。历史上，它并不以能有效应对这类灾害而闻名。

cues.en: Nairobi has a horrible drainage system. Its county government is saying that it's trying to repair that.
cues.zh: 内罗毕的排水系统糟糕透顶。该市郡政府称正努力修复。

cues.en: The Kenyan government says it's trying to make people stock up, especially in the northeast, and buy what they need before this happens.
cues.zh: 肯尼亚政府称正努力让民众，尤其是东北部地区的民众，在灾害发生前储备必需品。

cues.en: But again, this is something that might happen, and if it does happen, it could mean that these economies suffer greatly.
cues.zh: 但再说一次，这只是可能发生的事；如果发生，这些经济体可能遭受重创。

cues.en: Because higher-than-usual rainfall means the crops in these farm fields may be disrupted.
cues.zh: 因为高于正常水平的降雨意味着这些农田里的作物可能受损，

cues.en: These fields are meant to feed the countries' bread baskets, but they might face disruption.
cues.zh: 这些农田本应养活这些国家的粮仓地区，但可能遭遇破坏。

cues.en: Destroyed crops mean households will have to spend more. And after that, then comes maybe a cycle of drought and famine.
cues.zh: 作物被毁意味着家庭必须增加支出。之后，可能还会出现旱灾和饥荒的循环。

cues.en: So Somalia is already facing its worst famine in years.
cues.zh: 所以，索马里正面临多年来最严重的饥荒。

cues.en: This could be devastating on the drier front when famine follows the rainfall.
cues.zh: 降雨过后，饥荒可能在更干旱的一面造成灾难性后果。

cues.en: More immediately, in October, when higher-than-usual rainfall happens, most governments say they are prepared.
cues.zh: 更紧迫的是，面对十月的异常降雨，多数政府称已做好准备。

cues.en: But previous times they've been tested, they've proven not to be as prepared as they should have been.
cues.zh: 但过去接受考验时，它们都证明自己并没有应有的准备。

cues.en: Thomas, climate change is already causing extreme weather events in Africa.
cues.zh: 托马斯，气候变化已经在非洲造成极端天气。

cues.en: I guess this could worsen the impact of situations that El Niño could bring.
cues.zh: 我想，这可能加剧厄尔尼诺带来的影响。

cues.en: The impact of El Niño could be far-reaching. As I say, most people in these regions are already in lower-middle-income countries.
cues.zh: 厄尔尼诺的影响可能波及深远。正如我所说，这些地区大多数已经是中低收入国家。

cues.en: Somalia, Kenya and Uganda.
cues.zh: 索马里、肯尼亚和乌干达。

cues.en: If this happens and affects food supply, it could mean more than usual money going to food.
cues.zh: 如果灾害发生并影响粮食供应，人们可能要把更多钱花在食物上。

cues.en: And places like Somalia, already facing famine, will have less and less food.
cues.zh: 像索马里这样的饥荒国家，粮食会越来越少。

cues.en: Here in Kenya, communities living in informal settlements across Nairobi and outside Nairobi are in particular danger.
cues.zh: 在肯尼亚，生活在内罗毕及其外围非正规住区的社区尤其危险。

cues.en: Especially around the Nairobi River.
cues.zh: 尤其是在内罗毕河沿岸。

cues.en: A lot of communities along the Mathare area could be facing higher-than-usual rainfall.
cues.zh: 马萨雷地区沿岸许多社区可能面临高于正常水平的降雨。

cues.en: The river breaks its banks, and the shacks these people live in could endanger them.
cues.zh: 河水一旦决堤，这些人居住的简陋棚屋可能危及他们。

cues.en: This is a problem, and the government says that it's moving these people out of these areas, but the impact could be severe if it happens.
cues.zh: 这是个问题。政府称正把人们迁出这些地区，但如果灾害发生，影响可能很严重。

cues.en: Our Africa correspondent, Thomas Naadi.
cues.zh: 本台非洲记者托马斯·纳迪报道。

cues.en: As we were hearing there, severe climate change continues to affect the world as we know it.
cues.zh: 正如我们刚才听到的，严重的气候变化正持续影响我们所知的世界。

cues.en: The Danube is Europe's second-longest river, vital to energy supplies across the continent.
cues.zh: 多瑙河是欧洲第二长河，对整个欧洲大陆的能源供应至关重要。

cues.en: Especially in Austria, where more than half the country's energy comes from hydropower.
cues.zh: 尤其在奥地利，超过一半的能源来自水力发电。

cues.en: But the river is now at its lowest levels for 30 years due to droughts.
cues.zh: 但由于干旱，多瑙河水位目前处于30年来最低。

cues.en: Some industry insiders warn that the river is drying up, calling the shift in available energy sources a crisis and warning that higher costs are on the way.
cues.zh: 一些业内人士警告，多瑙河正在干涸；他们称可用能源转变是一场危机，并警告成本将会上升。

cues.en: Business Daily reporter Hannah Mullane has been speaking to one of them.
cues.zh: 《商业日报》记者汉娜·穆兰采访了其中一人。

cues.en: Along the Upper Danube in Germany and Austria, the river is used to power hydroelectric plants.
cues.zh: 在德国和奥地利的多瑙河上游，人们利用这条河为水电站发电。

cues.en: This is where the river is at its fastest as it tumbles through the mountains, and there are 59 dams on just the first 1,000 kilometres of the river.
cues.zh: 这里的河水穿过山脉奔流，速度最快；仅多瑙河最初一千公里就有59座大坝。

cues.en: So when the river runs low, so does energy production.
cues.zh: 所以河流水位低，能源产量也会下降。

cues.en: I am here at the Greifenstein hydropower plant, and it provides electricity for 400,000 households each year.
cues.zh: 我现在位于格赖芬施泰因水电站，它每年为40万户家庭供电。

cues.en: The level of water is far below its usual level.
cues.zh: 水位远低于通常水平。

cues.en: Florian Seidl is the spokesperson for Verbund, Austria's largest energy supplier.
cues.zh: 弗洛里安·赛德尔是奥地利最大能源供应商Verbund的发言人。

cues.en: He's speaking to me from the roof of the Greifenstein plant, where the river levels are very low and the capacity of the plant has been cut.
cues.zh: 他在格赖芬施泰因电站的屋顶接受我的采访，那里河流水位很低，电站产能也已削减。

cues.en: Nobody, no man alive, no colleagues have ever seen such things.
cues.zh: 没有人，没有一个活着的人，没有同事见过这样的情景。

cues.en: This is the visible effect of the man-made climate crisis.
cues.zh: 这是人为气候危机带来的显而易见的影响。

cues.en: Normally, we have 2 million litres of water each second—that's really a huge amount.
cues.zh: 通常每秒有200万升水流过，这真的是巨大的水量。

cues.en: But because of the drought, we have just about 600,000.
cues.zh: 但由于干旱，现在只有大约60万升。

cues.en: If the hydro plants reduce capacity, then less energy is produced, and that has an economic impact.
cues.zh: 如果水电站降低产能，发电量就会减少，从而产生经济影响。

cues.en: Verbund reported a loss of earnings totaling €370 million in the first six months of the year.
cues.zh: Verbund报告称，今年前六个月的收益损失总额达3.7亿欧元。

cues.en: That's more than $400 million, and a lot of that was because of the drought.
cues.zh: 这超过4亿美元，其中很大一部分是干旱造成的。

cues.en: We have to face two problems.
cues.zh: 我们必须面对两个问题。

cues.en: One is, of course, the lack of generation from our own hydropower, and the other was the decline of wholesale prices in Europe.
cues.zh: 一个当然是我们自身水力发电量不足，另一个是欧洲批发电价下跌。

cues.en: It's costing the business money. Overall, Austria has to import more energy to plug the gap until river levels improve—and that's expensive.
cues.zh: 这让企业蒙受损失，总体而言，奥地利不得不进口更多能源来填补水位恢复前的缺口，而这代价高昂。

cues.en: It may not have an impact on bills straight away,
cues.zh: 这可能不会立即影响账单，

cues.en: but if wholesale prices go up, then eventually it's likely to reach household bills at some point.
cues.zh: 但如果批发价上涨，最终很可能会在某个时候传导到家庭账单。

cues.en: So what's the answer? What does the future hold?
cues.zh: 那么答案是什么？未来会怎样？

cues.en: Austria relied always on hydropower, and we have never faced a crisis like this,
cues.zh: 奥地利一直依赖水力发电，我们从未面临过这样的危机，

cues.en: and so this will be the key for the future: to build up more wind power, more solar power, and of course more storage facilities.
cues.zh: 所以未来的关键是发展更多风电、太阳能，当然还要建设更多储能设施。

cues.en: People don't like windmills, but we need electricity.
cues.zh: 人们不喜欢风车，但我们需要电力。

cues.en: We need to get rid of fossil fuels because otherwise we won't manage the energy transition and the climate crisis.
cues.zh: 我们需要摆脱化石燃料，否则就无法应对能源转型和气候危机。

cues.en: The drought has certainly been a reminder of what needs to change.
cues.zh: 这场干旱无疑提醒我们需要改变什么。

cues.en: As we see more countries investing in wind and solar power, those renewable energies depend less on water.
cues.zh: 随着越来越多国家投资风能和太阳能，这些可再生能源对水的依赖较少。

cues.en: The impact on the energy sector may speed up this process as governments across Europe see the economic consequences of such extreme weather.
cues.zh: 随着欧洲各国政府看到极端天气造成的现实经济后果，这种对能源行业的影响甚至可能加快转型进程。

cues.en: Hannah Mullane reporting.
cues.zh: 汉娜·穆兰报道。

cues.en: The Australian Recording Industry Association says it's banning music primarily made by artificial intelligence from Australia's official charts.
cues.zh: 澳大利亚唱片业协会表示，将禁止主要由人工智能制作的音乐进入澳大利亚官方排行榜。

cues.en: The decision comes after a cover by Josh Fawaz of Madonna's Like a Prayer,
cues.zh: 这一决定出台前，乔什·法瓦兹翻唱了麦当娜的《Like a Prayer》，

cues.en: which soared towards the top of the charts last month, was revealed to have used AI-generated vocals and drums.
cues.zh: 这首歌上月冲上排行榜前列，后来被发现使用了人工智能生成的人声和鼓声。

cues.en: Our correspondent in Sydney, Simon Atkinson, told us more about the new rules.
cues.zh: 本台驻悉尼记者西蒙·阿特金森介绍了新规的更多情况。

cues.en: It's been very, very, very, very popular indeed.
cues.zh: 这首歌确实非常、非常、非常、非常受欢迎。

cues.en: I mean, it topped the dance singles chart here, peaked at number two in the overall chart, and it's been in the charts for over four months.
cues.zh: 我的意思是，它登上了这里的舞曲单曲榜榜首，在综合榜最高排名第二，而且已上榜四个多月。

cues.en: So it is hugely popular there. The producer is an Australian DJ, but it's probably the one song in this world of AI slop,
cues.zh: 所以它在那里很受欢迎。制作人是一名澳大利亚 DJ，但在这个所谓“人工智能垃圾”的世界里，它或许是唯一一首

cues.en: as people call it, that's really got people talking about how valid it should be that we have this kind of music in the charts.
cues.zh: 真正引发人们讨论的，是这类音乐进入排行榜究竟是否合理。

cues.en: It's a very fast-changing industry, and what this ban is seeking to do, it's not saying you can't use any AI in music.
cues.zh: 这是一个变化非常快的行业，而这项禁令并不是说音乐中完全不能使用人工智能。

cues.en: I mean, AI has been used in various forms for a long time. We think of autotune, perhaps that lyric in the Cher song Believe,
cues.zh: 我的意思是，人工智能以各种形式被使用已经很久了。比如自动调音，也许还有雪儿歌曲《Believe》中的那句歌词，

cues.en: perhaps the most famous example in recent years, is it?
cues.zh: 这算是近年来最著名的例子，也许是吧？

cues.en: But it's talking specifically about when it changes the nature of music, and what it's saying is
cues.zh: 但它具体针对的是人工智能改变音乐本质的情况；它所说的是，

cues.en: that all songs now must be substantially human-made to be eligible for the charts.
cues.zh: 现在所有歌曲都必须主要由人类创作，才有资格进入排行榜。

cues.en: It can still be used for drum machines and similar things,
cues.zh: 人工智能仍可用于鼓机之类的用途，

cues.en: but the vocals and the songs must be written by a human, the vocals must be human, and the lead instruments must be performed by humans.
cues.zh: 但歌曲必须由人类创作，人声必须由人类演唱，主奏乐器也必须由人类演奏。

cues.en: And if that's not the case, then they won't be eligible for the charts.
cues.zh: 如果不是这样，就没有资格进入排行榜。

cues.en: I think one of the interesting comments we've had already is from one of Australia's leading electronic dance groups, called Peking Duk.
cues.zh: 我认为，我们已经听到的一条有趣评论来自澳大利亚领先的电子舞曲组合 Peking Duk。

cues.en: They recently remixed one of their songs on social media, giving it an over-the-top AI version, and captioned it,
cues.zh: 他们最近在社交媒体上重新混音了自己的一首歌，制作了一个夸张的人工智能版本，并配文：

cues.en: "This is what happens when you re-record your own song with AI, so Australian radio will play it again."
cues.zh: “这就是用人工智能重新录制自己的歌曲会发生的事，所以澳大利亚电台会再次播放它。”

cues.en: Because, you know, people have latched onto it.
cues.zh: 因为，你知道，人们已经喜欢上它了。

cues.en: But one of the band members, speaking to local media today, talked about AI-generated music removing the human experience from life.
cues.zh: 但乐队成员之一今天接受当地媒体采访时说，人工智能生成的音乐正在从生活中移除人类体验。

cues.en: And Australia is trying to lead the way on many of these issues.
cues.zh: 而在澳大利亚，你知道，他们正试图在许多这类事务上走在前面。

cues.en: Of course, it brought in a social media ban, which has been copied in many parts of the world.
cues.zh: 当然，澳大利亚推出了社交媒体禁令，世界许多地方也仿效了这一做法。

cues.en: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese promised a lot more protection from AI for Australian creatives.
cues.zh: 总理安东尼·阿尔巴尼斯承诺，为澳大利亚创意工作者提供更多人工智能保护。

cues.en: But you can see why musicians might be leaning in on it.
cues.zh: 不过，你看，也就不难理解音乐人为什么可能会倾向于使用它。

cues.en: And of course, there's nothing to stop them still doing that.
cues.zh: 当然，没有什么能阻止他们继续这样做。

cues.en: It just means they wouldn't be eligible for those charts.
cues.zh: 这只是意味着，他们将没有资格进入这些排行榜。

cues.en: Artists will have to declare when they've used AI.
cues.zh: 顺便说一句，是否使用过人工智能，将由艺人负责申报。

cues.en: So they submit it to be considered for the charts, and they're supposed to list what kind of artificial intelligence has gone into it.
cues.zh: 他们提交作品参与排行榜评选时，应列明其中使用了哪种人工智能。

cues.en: But the organisation running the charts says if it later finds AI was used without declaration, it would recalculate the charts.
cues.zh: 但负责运营排行榜的机构表示，如果日后发现作品使用了人工智能却未申报，他们将重新计算排行榜。

cues.en: And if it happened to get to number one, well, they might well ask for the little trophy that you get to be given back.
cues.zh: 如果这首歌碰巧登上第一名，他们很可能会要求获奖者归还拿到的小奖杯。

cues.en: Our Sydney correspondent, Simon Atkinson.
cues.zh: 本台驻悉尼记者西蒙·阿特金森。

cues.en: And that's all from us for now. If you want to get in touch, you can email us at globalpodcast@bbc.co.uk.
cues.zh: 以上就是目前的全部报道。如果想联系我们，可以发送邮件至 globalpodcast@bbc.co.uk。

cues.en: You can also watch our episodes in full; just search for the Global News Podcast on YouTube.
cues.zh: 你也可以在 YouTube 上搜索 Global News Podcast，观看完整节目。

cues.en: This edition was mixed by Chris Hansen, and the producer was Stephanie Tillotson.
cues.zh: 本期由克里斯·汉森混音，制片人是斯蒂芬妮·蒂洛森。

cues.en: The editor is Karen Martin, and I'm Ankur Desai.
cues.zh: 编辑是凯伦·马丁，我是安库尔·德赛。

cues.en: Until next time, goodbye.
cues.zh: 下次再会，再见。
